resources.string: What a camera advertises does not guarantee the same frame rate while recording.

Reason: the range matches the request; the actual rate still has to be measured.
Reason: the camera advertises no range up to the requested maximum, the closest one was taken.
Reason: the camera\'s normal ranges do not reach 60 fps, so 60 was never requested (a settings limit, not a measurement).
Reason: the camera advertises 60 fps, but the encoder does not confirm 60 at this size, so 60 was not requested.
Reason: no suitable range is advertised, the camera default is used.
60 fps was never requested from the camera: recording was limited to 30 in advance. This does not prove the camera cannot do 60.
The camera delivered noticeably fewer frames than requested. Possible reasons: low light, heat, session limits.
Frames were lost during processing: the original recording has more of them than the final file.
The limiting stage is not established: not enough measurements.

BeyGram will open the selected cameras one by one for a few seconds in each advertised mode and count frames. No video or sound is recorded, frames are not saved or sent anywhere. The check may take up to two minutes and warm the phone a little; you can cancel it.
The check continues even if you close this window.
No camera access. Allow access and start the check again.
Check stopped: the phone is very hot.
Check stopped by the overall time limit.
Method: one stream without recording or sound; the rate is computed from sensor frame timestamps after a 0.8 s warm-up, 2 s of measurement per mode.
